title: Zheng Shangyou
tagline: Climb first. Leave the last seat behind.
taglineZh: 先出完的人坐上游，最后一张牌留在下游。

lines.en: Fifty-two cards. Three to six players. No jokers.
lines.zh: 五十二张牌，三到六个人，不用王。

lines.en: Zheng Shangyou. Climb from downstream to upstream.
lines.zh: 争上游。从下游一路打到上游。

lines.en: Lead a single, pair, triple, road or bomb. Beat it with a bigger set.
lines.zh: 出单张、对子、三张、顺子或炸弹，用更大的牌型压住。

lines.en: Two passes clear the trick. The last player to play leads again.
lines.zh: 两个人过牌就清空这一墩，最后出牌的人重新领出。

lines.en: Finish first for upstream. Last place is downstream, and the points follow.
lines.zh: 先出完当上游，最后一名是下游，得分也跟着排定。

lines.en: Next round, downstream pays tribute and upstream returns any card.
lines.zh: 下一局，下游进贡，上游回一张任意牌。

lines.en: Four computer levels, hot-seat, and private seats on your own network.
lines.zh: 四档电脑、同屏热座，还有自己网络里的私密座位。
